# PlayReady test fixture

`wrmheader_v4_3_0_0_aescbc_example.xml` is the public AESCBC example from
[Microsoft’s PlayReady Header Specification](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/playready/specifications/playready-header-specification), section 3.3.2.

Its identifiers and license URL are fictitious values from the specification.
The parser tests use this independent example to validate header version, key
identifiers, encryption algorithm, and custom attributes.
